title: Gundren departs

sourceRecords.title: 1 · Gundren rides ahead
read: The wagon is loaded with mining supplies and road provisions. Gundren Rockseeker checks the straps one last time while Sildar waits beside their horses. The dwarf grins, but he seems impatient to get to Phandalin. “Take this to Barthen’s Provisions. I’ll meet you there.”

Gundren turns to Donavan. “If the mine holds anything unusual, write down what you actually see before anyone decides what it is worth.” To Trista, he adds, “Make sure I come back to read his account.” To Ringgo: “Choose the safe camp over the fast one. I hired you to bring people through.”

brief: Gundren Rockseeker, sturdy dwarf with weathered auburn beard, mounted and turning back to speak beside loaded mining-supply wagon on damp woodland road from Neverwinter. Sildar, older human warrior near fifty in travel armor, mounted slightly ahead. TWO riders, no depicted player characters or Dracuseth. Morning after rain, muted amber daylight, ordinary road and mining bundles. No secret tokens, portals or missing persons outcome.
